data.description: Build a layered responsive testing system that validates every route across accurate width/height, touch/hover, orientation, browser-engine, text-scaling, and safe-area conditions; add real Android/iOS device-cloud execution rather than relying on Chrome presets; reconcile prior FRAC-11 browser-gate work; use the suite to validate and repair the homepage hero clipping on Galaxy S24-class short visible viewports; document secrets and physical-device release acceptance.
data.title: Real-device responsive test system and mobile hero validation

data.body: Pre-fix red proof captured before Hero edits at a simulated touch/mobile 360x640 visual viewport (DPR 3): document scrollWidth 376 > clientWidth 360 (16px horizontal overflow); Hero is forced to 640px high; absolute mobile footer occupies y=460.125..640 (179.875px); Story CTA occupies y=558..608. Screenshot: /tmp/frac17-pre-red-galaxy-class.png. This is local simulation evidence only, not a real-device pass.

Implementation complete. Core gates passed: pnpm typecheck, pnpm test (157 tests), pnpm build, pnpm conformance, and pnpm test:e2e:fast (119 cases: 105 passed, 14 annotated skips). The credential preflight correctly exits 2 when BrowserStack secrets are absent. Physical Android/iOS execution and Samsung Internet release evidence remain unrun because no BrowserStack credentials/device access are configured.
